E_md_gpa.basis: Mylar A datasheet 3.6–3.8 GPa MD; midpoint

E_cd_gpa.basis: Mylar A datasheet 3.8–4.1 GPa TD; midpoint

nu.basis: typical PET film value (rsE §b table script) [E]

crease_length_scale_t.source: Lechenault, Thiria & Adda-Bedia 2014, Mechanical response of a creased sheet, PRL 112, 244301 — https://arxiv.org/abs/1404.1243
crease_length_scale_t.method: single-crease opening moment M = κW(φ−φ0) on Mylar strips

tear_strain.basis: biaxially oriented PET elongates far beyond paper [E]

crease_set_rate.basis: polymer film springs back more than paper [E]

fabrication.score: recommended; scoring gives a cleaner hinge

provenance.author: Innovaciones MADFAM
sources: Lechenault, Thiria & Adda-Bedia 2014, Mechanical response of a creased sheet, PRL 112, 244301 — https://arxiv.org/abs/1404.1243
Pliego research memo rsE (2026-10-10) §b material default table — engineering estimates [E] unless a source is cited

caliper_mm.basis: derived.thickness; physical.caliper_um nominal: film grade designation

areal_density_kg_m2.basis: derived.areal_density (g/mm²) × 1000; physical.gsm estimated: density ≈ 1.39–1.40 g/cm³ × 125 µm (Mylar A datasheet)

E1t.basis: derived.E_md × t; physical.E_md_gpa estimated: Mylar A datasheet 3.6–3.8 GPa MD; midpoint; physical.caliper_um nominal: film grade designation

E2t.basis: derived.E_cd × t; physical.E_cd_gpa estimated: Mylar A datasheet 3.8–4.1 GPa TD; midpoint; physical.caliper_um nominal: film grade designation

G12t.basis: derived.G12 × t, G12 = 0.387·√(E_md·E_cd) (Baum, Brennan & Habeger 1981, via pliego.stock.derive v1)

nu12.basis: ν12 = ν·√(E_md/E_cd): the card's ν is the geometric mean √(ν12·ν21), split by reciprocity ν12/E1 = ν21/E2; physical.nu estimated: typical PET film value (rsE §b table script) [E]

D11.basis: derived.D_md × 1e-9 (N·m), plate E·t³/(12(1−ν²)) in pliego.stock.derive v1; physical.E_md_gpa estimated: Mylar A datasheet 3.6–3.8 GPa MD; midpoint; physical.nu estimated: typical PET film value (rsE §b table script) [E]; physical.caliper_um nominal: film grade designation

D22.basis: derived.D_cd × 1e-9 (N·m), plate E·t³/(12(1−ν²)) in pliego.stock.derive v1; physical.E_cd_gpa estimated: Mylar A datasheet 3.8–4.1 GPa TD; midpoint; physical.nu estimated: typical PET film value (rsE §b table script) [E]; physical.caliper_um nominal: film grade designation

D66.basis: G12·t³/12 with the estimated G12 above

crease_length_scale_t.basis: physical.crease_length_scale_t measured: Lechenault, Thiria & Adda-Bedia 2014, Mechanical response of a creased sheet, PRL 112, 244301 — https://arxiv.org/abs/1404.1243

crease_yield_deg.basis: physical.crease_yield_deg estimated: rest opening 27–43° measured on Mylar (Lechenault 2014)

crease_set_rate.basis: physical.crease_set_rate estimated: polymer film springs back more than paper [E]

score_factor.basis: pliego.stock.derive v1 default (card has no physical.score_factor)

notes: friction: the card states one paper-on-paper coefficient; it is written as friction_static, and friction_kinetic and damping are left out rather than invented
